messages:
jessica: FYI Acme (raj) just escalated a privacy check before we kick off the POC. they need: DPA + SCCs, a short DSAR/deletion SLA, and a limited set of SIG/CAIQ answers scoped to POC only. they want this packaged by Mon EOD or they'll push the start.

mike: understoood. can we limit CAIQ to items relevant to the POC infra (storage, access controls, incident response)? avoids full org-level answers.

sara: @jessica what data classes again? PII only? any legal/financial or healthcare items?

jessica: just user messages, email addresses, display names, account ids. explicitly no PHI or financial account numbers. retention: customer wants account close -> full deletion within 30 days.

oliver: drafting DPA paragraph now. proposed language: 
```
Data Deletion: Following verified Customer request to delete an account, Redwood will remove Customer Data from active storage within 30 days. Exclusions: aggregated telemetry and billing records necessary for fraud detection and invoicing, retained up to 90 days and pseudonymized where applicable.
```

legal-amy: we can sign to not train on customer data. i'll add: "Redwood will not use Customer Data to train or improve models without Customer's explicit prior written consent."

mike: technically for the POC we can show an export endpoint + delete flow. sample export curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/export -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"user_id":"abcd-1234"}'
```
and deletion will trigger S3 delete + model-kv purge.

sara: i'll pull our subprocessors list and attach a short attestation: TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest, KMS-managed keys, RBAC via SSO, and SOC2 Type II. keep it to one page.

jessica: great. about SCCs: we have the standard EU SCC addendum. can legal-amy sign that or do we need sales to do final?

legal-amy: i can sign the SCC addendum for POC scope. we'll append subprocessors and a scoped CAIQ subset. please note: any agreement beyond POC (training, retention changes) needs explicit signoff.

mike: i'll create a minimal CAIQ subset doc with a few TBDs (networking ops items) so we can move fast.

oliver: include a short ops snippet showing how deletion impacts model cache: 
```
model_cache:
  purge_on_user_delete: true
  retention_days: 0
```

jessica: timeline: i'll bundle DPA snippet, SCC addendum, CAIQ subset, attestation, and export/delete examples into a single zipped packet and email Raj Mon 09:00. who can review before send?

sara: i'll review the security attestation tonight.

mike: i'll QA the export/delete examples and add a note about audit logs (we retain delete audit for 90 days for compliance).

legal-amy: i'll proof the DPA paragraph and sign the SCC addendum for POC. add me to the shared doc.

sec-bot: shared doc created at /shared/poc-acme/1770001115 by jessica

jessica: thanks all. quick ask: include a simple sentence in the packet about DSARs: "Redwood will assist customers to locate and export personal data; verified DSARs are fulfilled within 30 days." i'll send once legal-amy confirms. :wave:
